note: T796. One entry per env seam that test\win32 SETS and src\ READS. `class` says what the seam does; `unset` says what happens to the state the seam hides - shipped-elsewhere (every other run uses it), armed (`unsetArm` names the arm that aims at it), gap (`gap` names the open task), unreachable (`note` says why this box cannot exercise it). See test\win32\lib\SeamAudit.ps1 for the rule and test\win32\seam-audit.ps1 for the enforcement.

GHOSTTY_ACCOUNT_STORE.note: unset is the user's real account.json under %LOCALAPPDATA%\ghoztty; a test must never read or write it.

GHOSTTY_ADOPT_DISABLE.note: unset = adoption runs, which is what every other agent run does.

GHOSTTY_ADOPT_INSTALL_DIR.note: unset is the real install dir; adopting it would take over the user's installed agent.

GHOSTTY_ADOPT_INTERVAL_MS.note: unset = the shipped sweep interval, which every non-adopt run uses.

GHOSTTY_ADOPT_RUNKEY_NAME.note: unset is the real HKCU Run value that starts the user's agent at sign-in.

GHOSTTY_ADOPT_UNINSTALL_CMD.note: unset runs the real uninstall command for the installed product.

GHOSTTY_AGENT_HEARTBEAT.note: unset is the live agent's heartbeat file; writing it would perturb the user's sessions.

GHOSTTY_AGENT_LOCK.note: unset is the live agent's single-instance lock - taking it evicts the user's agent.

GHOSTTY_AGENT_MAX_SESSIONS.note: unset = the shipped session cap; every other agent run is under it.

GHOSTTY_AGENT_QUIET_ATTACH.note: unset = the agent applies an attaching client's geometry to the child, which on this seat makes ConPTY repaint - what every other agent run does.

GHOSTTY_AGENT_RING_BYTES.note: unset = the shipped scrollback ring size, used by every other agent run.

GHOSTTY_AGENT_SUPPRESS_CAPS.note: unset = the agent advertises its real capabilities, as in every other run.

GHOSTTY_DEVICE_TOKEN.note: unset is the enrolled device's real relay token.

GHOSTTY_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.note: T747, the defect this whole audit exists for: with no id the chooser must draw no sign-in button at all. Section 8 launches without the id; sections 1-7 are its control.

GHOSTTY_HOST_DEFAULTS.note: unset is the user's real per-host defaults store.

GHOSTTY_LOCAL_AGENT_BIN.note: All 49 agent scripts override it, so agentBinary's default branch - ghoztty-agent.exe beside our own exe, the branch every delivered build takes - has never run under test.

GHOSTTY_OAUTH_AUTH_ENDPOINT.note: unset is Google's real authorization endpoint.

GHOSTTY_RELAY_BASE.note: unset is the production relay service.

GHOSTTY_RELAY_ENV.note: unset is the enrolled device's real relay env file.

GHOSTTY_RELAY_TOKEN.note: unset is the user's real relay credential.

GHOSTTY_SHARING_CONFIG.note: unset is the real sharing config beside the user's sessions.json.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_AUTOSTART.unsetArm: test\win32\agent-autostart.ps1::C3 no Run value written by a debug build
GHOZTTY_AGENT_AUTOSTART.note: force/gate reach a Run-key write a debug build refuses; section C launches with the seam removed and proves the refusal, with section A as its positive control.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_BUNDLED_VERSION.note: unset = the real bundled agent stamp, read by every other agent run.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_DURABLE_ACK.note: unset = durable acks on, the default every other session runs with.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_HANDOFF_FORCE.note: unset = handoff happens only when the agent decides to, as in every other run.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_HOLDER_REPLAY_BYTES.note: unset = session.default_holder_replay_bytes, which every other holder uses.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_HOME.note: unset is the user's real agent state directory.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_INSTANCE.note: unset is the default lineage - the endpoints the user's live agent owns. A dev build must never join them.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_PROTO_VERSION.note: unset = the build's real protocol version; the skew cases are the exception.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_PTY_FLAVOR.note: unset = .local, the flavor every other agent run spawns.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_PTY_HOLDER.note: Holder-backed is the default since T909; the seam is the OFF switch, so unset is what every other session takes.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_RESOLVE_DELAY_MS.note: T1688. Stretches the local-agent resolve so a +new-window lands inside it on purpose; unset = the real (short) resolve, which section B of resolve-window-persist.ps1 and every other launch run.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_SNAPSHOT_VOLUME_BYTES.note: unset = the shipped snapshot volume threshold.

GHOZTTY_AGENT_VANISH_SWEEP.note: unset = the vanish sweep runs, the default for every other agent.

GHOZTTY_CHROME_FANOUT_LEGACY.note: unset = the post-T1345 fan-out, which every other window paints with.

GHOZTTY_CLAUDE_EXE.note: Both scripts point it at a stub, so findClaude only ever returns from its override branch; the PATH walk and install-location fallback have no coverage of any kind.

GHOZTTY_CLAUDE_SETUP.note: unset = the shipped setup gating, taken by every other launch.

GHOZTTY_CLAUDE_STATE_DIR.note: unset is the user's real Claude state directory.

GHOZTTY_DEBUG_MARKER.note: unset = the marker's default state, which every other window draws.

GHOZTTY_DRAG_SERIAL_WAIT.note: unset = the shipped frame pacing during a drag.

GHOZTTY_ENROLL_NO_OPEN.note: unset = enrollment opens a browser, which is what a real enrollment does; suppressed here only so a test does not launch one.

GHOZTTY_GL_FALLBACK_DLL.note: unset = the real GL loader path, used by every other launch.

GHOZTTY_GL_FORCE_VERSION.note: unset = the driver's real GL version, as in every other launch.

GHOZTTY_GL_SIMULATE_REBUILD_FAILURES.note: unset = a lost-device rebuild succeeds or fails on its own merits; gl-device-lost.ps1 arm A and every real reset run it that way.

GHOZTTY_GL_SIMULATE_RESET_AFTER.note: unset = only the driver's real reset status can report a loss; gl-device-lost.ps1 arm C is that state and asserts nothing is ever reported lost.

GHOZTTY_HANDOFF_COMMIT.note: unset = this build's real commit stamp.

GHOZTTY_HANDOFF_PROMPT.note: unset = the shipped prompt gating for a handoff.

GHOZTTY_HANDOFF_VERSION.note: unset = this build's real version stamp.

GHOZTTY_INSTALL_UNLOCK.note: unset = the installer's real unlock arguments.

GHOZTTY_IPC_NO_RESOLVE_DEFER.note: T1688. The OFF switch for holding +new-window across a local-agent resolve, set only by resolve-window-persist.ps1 -NegativeControl; unset = the fix on, which every other run takes.

GHOZTTY_IPC_SOCKET.note: unset is the per-user endpoint the installed release owns; a dev build must never drive it.

GHOZTTY_IPC_TIMEOUT_MS.note: unset = the shipped IPC timeout, used by every other CLI call.

GHOZTTY_NO_STARTUP_ESCAPE.note: unset = the startup job escape runs, as in every other launch.

GHOZTTY_ORPHAN_CHECK_MS.note: unset = the shipped orphan poll interval.

GHOZTTY_PAINT_PROBE.note: unset = no probe instrumentation, which is what every other launch paints with.

GHOZTTY_PANE_ID.note: unset = the app stamps the real pane id into the child environment, as in every other pane.

GHOZTTY_PATH_SELFHEAL.note: unset = the PATH self-heal runs under its own gates, as in every other launch.

GHOZTTY_PERF.note: unset = no perf logging, the state every other launch is in.

GHOZTTY_PIPE_SUFFIX.note: unset is the user's live named pipe. Isolating is a standing safety rule (docs\claude\build.md), not a convenience.

GHOZTTY_RELAUNCH_GUARD.note: unset = no relaunch in flight, which is the state of every ordinary launch.

GHOZTTY_RELAY_NO_CLIENT_ID.note: The forcing seam for T747's unconfigured state; unset = whatever the build really carries.

GHOZTTY_RELAY_PERF_DIR.note: unset = no relay perf sampling, the state every other run is in.

GHOZTTY_RESTORE_PROBE_UNKNOWN.note: unset = the real probe verdict, as in every other restore.

GHOZTTY_RESTORE_PULL_DELAY_MS.note: unset = no injected delay, the shipped restore timing.

GHOZTTY_RESTORE_SKIP.note: unset = restore runs, which is what every restore test and every real launch does.

GHOZTTY_STARTUP_FAIL.note: unset = startup succeeds, as in every other launch.

GHOZTTY_TEST_BREAK_UTF16.note: unset = the real byte <-> UTF-16 conversion, which every composer run including viewer-feedback-utf16.ps1's own default run uses; -BreakUtf16 is its teeth check (T1710).

GHOZTTY_TRAY_FAIL.note: unset = the tray icon is created normally.

GHOZTTY_UPDATE_APPLY.note: unset = an ordinary launch rather than the staged-apply child; every other GUI start proves it.

GHOZTTY_UPDATE_URL.note: unset is the real GitHub releases feed for dzearing/ghoztty; an acceptance run must not depend on the network or on what is actually published.

GHOZTTY_URL_SCHEME.note: unset = the ghoztty:// registration self-heal under its own gates, as in every other launch.

GHOZTTY_USER_ENV.note: unset = the user-env overlay is on, which is what every other pane spawns with.

GHOZTTY_WEBVIEW2_BROWSER_DIR.note: unset = the installed WebView2 runtime, used by every viewer pane in every other run.

GHOZTTY_WHATS_NEW_VERSION.note: unset = this build's real version, which decides the What's New window everywhere else.

GHOZTTY_WINDOW_NAME.note: unset = the app stamps the real window name into the child environment, as in every other window.
